description: Scores every DUE, unscored prediction (log_prediction) as 'hit', 'miss' or 'unresolvable' and stores the outcome in ~/.suunto-mcp/predictions.json; toward Suunto it only reads. Rules: session_done = a workout exists on the date; hrv_in_band = HRV of the night after the date within the 28-day band, inclusive; recovery_morning_at_least = waking Balance after that night at least the threshold; reps_hit = the journal's logged sets decide (without them only fewer set laps than predicted in a reliable per-set guide proves a miss). Only workouts after the prediction was made count. A missing workout or night leaves the prediction PENDING (with the reason) until the watch has synced a LATER day: a missing sync is never scored. UNRESOLVABLE (no HRV that night, under 7 nights for a band, nothing logged) is never guessed and counts as neither hit nor miss. A failed request leaves it unscored (see `errors`), retried next call. Scored outcomes are final; unresolvable ones are re-read only with rescoreUnresolvable: true. At most 20 per call, oldest first: `remaining` says how many are left. Demo mode scores a synthetic ledger in memory. Annotated not read-only (writes outcomes locally), not idempotent; nothing changes at Suunto.

rescoreUnresolvable.description: true: also re-read 'unresolvable' predictions (more data may have arrived). Default false.

name: score_predictions
title: Score due predictions against Suunto's data (hit / miss / unresolvable)
